description: Call this when the user asks how much Bitcoin is vulnerable to a quantum computer, about quantum-exposed supply, P2PK coins, or Satoshi-era exposure. Returns the latest daily measurement from ByKaranteli's own Bitcoin Core node: exposed BTC and its share of held value and UTXO count, composition by script family, dormancy cohorts, the dormant-P2PK watch set, and provenance hashes (base_height, base_hash, txoutset_hash) so any figure can be re-verified against any node.
name: get_quantum_exposure
title: Quantum-exposed Bitcoin (daily first-party measurement)
